Interface AIiTransactionRollbackActionExecutor<IN extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionInput,OUT extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionOutput,AO extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionAttemptOutput,CTX extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionExecutionContext<?>>

Type Parameters:
IN - rollback input
OUT - rollback output
AO - rollback attempt output

All Superinterfaces:
eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionExecutor<IN,OUT,AO,CTX>
public interface AIiTransactionRollbackActionExecutor<IN extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionInput,OUT extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionOutput,AO extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionAttemptOutput,CTX extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionExecutionContext<?>> extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.engine.AIiActionExecutor<IN,OUT,AO,CTX>
Executor dedicated to a rollback action owned and scheduled by a transaction. The rollback phase uses the ordinary worker/service/resource limits and emits ordinary action attempt results, but its failure must not recursively trigger an unlimited rollback of itself.
